source.evidence: Retail capture lab/reports/original-minigame-packets racing-*-op33 and the raw packets_racing_minigame.pcapng: five AI 33/11 blocks (vehicles), the seven racers' guids (slot*0x10 << 32 | 0x01700652), the seven 35/2 AddNpc bodies (frames 16794-17349, 334 bytes; driver_npc_hex is the slot 1 body, and the seven differ only in actor guid, name, model and grid position), the grid offsets of the first eight 33/5 frames (slots 1-7 at +-10/+-5/0 m across and 0/25/50 m ahead of slot 0, all at the start height), and the 33/14 stream (i32 @0x08 place, f32 @0x0c gap to the leader, f32 @0x10 distance to run, f32 @0x1d the racer's current-lap clock, four leader guids @0x29; all eight rows about every 50 ms) and the first AI lap (53.49 s on the 1805 m Wildwood loop). Roster by slot: Lily Leadfoot 19358 (871), Zoomer Rex 19359 (872), Jet Swiftpass 19363 (891), Layla Octane 19361 (888), Mai Redline 19362 (888), Connor Rush 19364 (869), Screamin' Steven 19344 (891). Rival names 101902, 394366, 101905, 101908, 101910, 101907, 395167, 101920, 101923 (Mirana Vega, row 651: MiniGameData description 3466 'place higher than Mirana Vega').

(R) Pace per slot, the per-track lap seconds of the pace-1.0 racer (Wildwood 53.5 s is the capture; the others sit just under the wiki's sprint-challenge par laps: Frost Ridge 28 s, Thunder Falls 48 s, Tangletrack 70 s; Sandstorm has no par), the rival rows' paces (difficulty 1 0.84, 2 0.90, 3 0.95), the row pace scales, the 6 s join onto the loop, the 20 Hz poses, the 20 Hz board (the capture's rate), the slot 1 and 4 kart bodies (the capture holds five AI 33/11 for seven racers), and the rival taking slot 4. Every number is tunable here.
